description.en: scripts/check-e2e-case-keys.sh (wired into ./scripts/check.sh --quick) rejects VQA gaps in playwright-e2e.json, duplicate external_key across seed fragments, and @VQA/@VUE tags that do not resolve.
description.uk: scripts/check-e2e-case-keys.sh відхиляє прогалини VQA у playwright-e2e.json, дублікати external_key та невідомі @VQA/@VUE теги.
description.fr: scripts/check-e2e-case-keys.sh rejects VQA gaps, duplicate external_key, and unresolved @VQA/@VUE tags.
description.es: scripts/check-e2e-case-keys.sh rejects VQA gaps, duplicate external_key, and unresolved @VQA/@VUE tags.
description.de: scripts/check-e2e-case-keys.sh rejects VQA gaps, duplicate external_key, and unresolved @VQA/@VUE tags.

description.en: NEVER run node e2e/scripts/sync-vulyk-case-links.mjs on a parallel feature branch (it historically skipped reading playwright-e2e.json and rewrote keys). Append the next free VQA to playwright-e2e.json and the next free VUE to e2e/cases/; prefer other sample cases in fragments with keys omitted. sync is additive unless --force-renumber.
description.uk: НІКОЛИ не запускайте sync-vulyk-case-links.mjs на feature branch. Додавайте наступний вільний VQA/VUE вручну; інші sample cases — у фрагментах без ключів. sync адитивний, окрім --force-renumber.
description.fr: NEVER run sync-vulyk-case-links.mjs on a feature branch; append keys manually; sync is additive unless --force-renumber.
description.es: NEVER run sync-vulyk-case-links.mjs on a feature branch; append keys manually; sync is additive unless --force-renumber.
